name: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle Inc.
summary: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. operates as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC). Its primary objective is to facilitate a significant corporate transaction, such as a merger, an exchange of capital stock, the acquisition of assets or shares, a reorganization, or a similar business integration with one or more existing enterprises. The entity was established on July 24, 2025, and its main offices are located in Miami, Florida.
